title: Revenue must nearly double
insight: Mainland net revenue is planned to rise from ~TZS 40tn to ~TZS 75tn (16.7% CAGR) and tax-to-GDP from 14.5% to 18%.
evidence: Revenue projections and yield targets.

title: Digital & data is the primary lever
insight: The largest transformation bet is KPA 2 — automation, integration, analytics and AI — as the engine for revenue and efficiency.
evidence: KPA 2 scope: automation to 100%, systems 90→300, AI/ML models.

title: Widen the base into the informal economy
insight: Bringing informal and digital-economy actors into the net is a core growth path, not just enforcement.
evidence: Informal-sector registration/participation and non-resident digital KPIs.

title: Rebuild trust and voluntary compliance
insight: Growth is pursued through fairness, transparency and service — a stakeholder-trust index anchors KPA 3.
evidence: Stakeholder trust index 75→98; voluntary-compliance KPIs.

title: Systems integration unlocks everything
insight: Analytics, risk models and self-service depend on integrating internal and external systems and data quality first.
evidence: Systems 90→300; data-quality and freshness pre-conditions.

title: Data-sharing law and partners
insight: Third-party data (government and private) is needed for informal-sector insight and compliance — requires legal mandates and partners.
evidence: New data-sharing agreements and third-party integration KPIs.

title: Financing must be front-loaded
insight: Capital (especially ICT) is planned early; delays in the ~TZS 10.6tn financing would push all downstream targets.
evidence: Front-loaded capital financing assumption; ~TZS 10,596bn requirement.

title: Workforce capacity precedes delivery
insight: Targets assume ~13,428 skilled staff and major reskilling; hiring/skills lag would bottleneck delivery.
evidence: Workforce 8,775→13,428; digital-skills and training KPIs.

title: Skills scarcity
insight: Specialised ICT, analytics, AI and cybersecurity talent is scarce regionally and may be hard to hire and retain.
evidence: Skills-based hiring emphasis; digital-skills targets.

title: Cybersecurity & data exposure
insight: More systems, integrations and shared data enlarge the attack surface and privacy risk.
evidence: Cyber-threat reduction and data-governance breach KPIs.

title: Legacy systems & integration
insight: Ageing infrastructure and incomplete digitalisation are named barriers that could slow the digital agenda.
evidence: Structural barriers: ICT performance and poor data integration.

title: Financing & DP dependency
insight: Reliance on stable government budgets and development-partner support exposes the plan to fiscal shifts.
evidence: Financing assumptions on government and DP support.

title: Change adoption
insight: A transformation this broad can stall if staff and taxpayers do not adopt new systems and behaviours.
evidence: Change-adoption and stakeholder-training KPIs from 0% baselines.

title: Analytics & AI capability
insight: Moving from few to many production AI/ML models implies a capability the institution is still building.
evidence: AI/ML models 2→10; analytics-driven eligibility from 0%.

title: Informal-economy insight
insight: TRA explicitly flags marginal insight into the informal economy as a structural barrier to close.
evidence: Structural barrier: size of the informal economy.

title: Organisational & project capacity
insight: Capacity gaps in planning, project execution, change and procurement are named barriers.
evidence: Structural barrier: organisational design and capacity gaps.

title: Third-party & digital data
insight: Access to third-party and digital-platform data is a high-leverage move to widen the base cheaply.
evidence: Third-party data integration and non-resident digital KPIs.

title: ITA as a talent & research engine
insight: Scaling ITA training, certification and research can supply the very skills the plan needs.
evidence: ITA programme, e-learning, exchange and research KPIs.

title: Interoperable, secure platforms
insight: Delivery hinges on systems that integrate cleanly, stay up (99.9%+) and are secure by design.
evidence: Integration, uptime and cybersecurity KPIs.

title: Trust as a growth strategy
insight: Sustained revenue depends on taxpayers experiencing fair, simple, transparent service.
evidence: Trust index, service and public-reporting KPIs.

title: From enforcement to service
insight: A quiet shift runs through CP-7: growth via better service, data and trust rather than enforcement alone.
evidence: Voluntary compliance, self-service and stakeholder KPIs across KPAs.

title: Institution-building, not just collection
insight: Ethics, ESG, wellbeing, research and capability signal a bid to become a modern, credible institution.
evidence: KPA 4 ethics/ESG/health and KPA 3 research/ESG KPIs.
